_note: EXPLORATORY. Phase- and genotype-based adjustment is a product rule, not clinical evidence. Full literature in parameters_evidence.json.

provenance.base_carb_pct: Control diets ~45% energy from carbohydrate; low-carb defined as <45% (PMID 31885557, 8 RCTs, 327 women with PCOS). Study definition, not a universal target.
provenance.carb_floor_pct: ASSUMPTION. Keeps output near the studied range.
provenance.max_carb_reduction_pct: ASSUMPTION (exploratory product rule). No source for genotype- or phase-based reduction.
provenance.base_fiber_g: General adult reference: 25 g/day for women 19-50 (DRI). Not PCOS-specific.
provenance.max_extra_fiber_g: 0 = no phase adjustment. Any value above 0 is an assumption.
provenance.base_protein_g_per_kg: General adult RDA 0.8 g/kg/day. Not PCOS-specific.
provenance.max_extra_protein_g_per_kg: 0 = no phase adjustment. Any value above 0 is an assumption.
provenance.high_insulin_uIU_mL: null: no universal insulin/HOMA-IR cutoff is supported (2023 international PCOS guideline; 75 g OGTT preferred). Population-specific cutoffs, e.g. Korean HOMA-IR in PMID 31542165, must not be applied universally.
provenance.insulin_extra_carb_reduction_pct: 0 while the insulin threshold is null.

guideline_context: International PCOS guideline (PMID 32452622): lifestyle first-line, no specific diet composition recommended. PMID 24914605: low-carb adds ~1-5% weight loss vs standard diet, no consistent extra endocrine benefit. PMID 23420000: weight loss helps regardless of diet composition.
